name: atlas-studio
description: Atlas Studio workspace. Rust engineering semantics live under core/runtime/adapter; TypeScript UI lives under apps/studio; .atlas is the sole repository knowledge root.

scripts.atlas:contract: cargo run -p atlas-cli --bin atlas-systemizer -- contract --format json
scripts.atlas:docs:audit: cargo run -p atlas-cli --bin atlas-systemizer -- docs audit --root .atlas
scripts.atlas:code:analyze: cargo run -p atlas-cli --bin atlas-systemizer -- code analyze --root .
